summary: This bill prevents individuals subject to a court order prohibiting them from possessing firearms during pretrial release from purchasing guns by adding this prohibition to the categories of persons denied firearms under federal law and providing grants to states to report such orders to the national background check system.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends federal law to prohibit individuals subject to a pretrial release order that restricts firearm possession from purchasing or receiving firearms. It also provides funding for states to report such orders to the national background check system, making it a central piece of gun control legislation aimed at stricter rules.

The bill integrates pretrial release orders, which are a component of the criminal justice system, into firearm background checks. By doing so, it strengthens the enforcement mechanisms related to court orders concerning individuals awaiting trial, thus leaning towards stricter justice in the context of firearm possession.
